// diagnostic

E3314

Target `{target}` has an invalid `{fact}` fact: {detail}.

What

Target `{target}` has an invalid `{fact}` fact: {detail}.

Why

Target memory, linker, allocator, panic, startup, and execution facts are explicit inputs to sema and cannot be recovered safely from a triple.

Fix

Select a complete typed target profile and correct the `{fact}` declaration.
